test_cases.name: happy_path_full_saga_commit
test_cases.description: All forward steps execute successfully, checkpoints are persisted sequentially in journal, and saga commits cleanly.
test_cases.input: Execute saga saga-commit-001 with 3 steps: step 1 init config, step 2 generate models, step 3 run migrations.

test_cases.name: mid_saga_failure_lifo_rollback
test_cases.description: Step 3 fails forward execution, triggering coordinator to execute compensating actions for step 2 then step 1 in reverse LIFO order.
test_cases.input: Execute saga saga-rollback-002 where step 1 and step 2 succeed, but step 3 fails on linting check.
expected_output_patterns: [COMPENSATION_START] Saga: saga-rollback-002 Step: 2 Rolling back write_client
[COMPENSATION_START] Saga: saga-rollback-002 Step: 1 Rolling back create_dir
=== SAGA ABORTED & RESTORED: saga-rollback-002 CompensatedSteps: [2 down to 1] ===

test_cases.name: step_one_immediate_failure_zero_rollback
test_cases.description: Step 1 fails immediately; saga aborts with zero compensations since no previous steps succeeded.
test_cases.input: Execute saga saga-step1-003 where step 1 fails due to filesystem permission error.

test_cases.name: preflight_missing_compensating_action
test_cases.description: Pre-flight validation rejects saga definition where a mutating forward step lacks a declared compensating action.
test_cases.input: Submit saga definition saga-invalid-004 where step 2 has no compensating action declared.

test_cases.name: compensation_action_failed_emergency_halt
test_cases.description: Compensating action encounters unrecoverable failure across retries during rollback, triggering fatal alert and emergency halt.
test_cases.input: Execute saga saga-fatal-005 where step 2 fails and compensating action for step 1 permanently fails.
expected_output_patterns: [COMPENSATION_START] Saga: saga-cleanup-005 Step: 1 Rolling back lock_resource
[COMPENSATION_FATAL] Saga: saga-cleanup-005 Step: 1 Failed to undo changes
prohibited_output_patterns: === SAGA ABORTED & RESTORED: saga-fatal-005 CompensatedSteps: [1 down to 1] ===
